tactics:
induction t with
  | head as => exact List.Mem.below.head
  | tail b h ih => exact List.Mem.below.tail ih (F _ h ih)

induction t with
  | head => constructor
  | tail b h ih => constructor <;> first | exact ih | exact F _ h ih
induction t <;> constructor <;> first | assumption | apply F <;> assumption
induction t <;> constructor <;> (try assumption) <;> apply F <;> assumption
